##### Project general facts

Elvira is a contemporary residential development by Emaar Properties. The project offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to combine comfort, functionality, and modern urban living. Positioned alongside Dubai Hills Park, the development benefits from green surroundings and views of the landscaped outdoor spaces, while its location provides convenient access to key destinations across the city.

The development offers a lifestyle centred on outdoor recreation, relaxation, and everyday convenience. Residents benefit from direct access to Dubai Hills Park, with its green spaces and recreational facilities, as well as proximity to Dubai Hills Mall. The wider community provides access to a variety of leisure, retail, educational, and healthcare facilities, supporting a comfortable lifestyle for individuals and families.

The apartments feature contemporary interiors with streamlined architectural details, large windows that maximise natural light, and neutral material palettes that create a warm and understated atmosphere. Open-plan layouts enhance the sense of space, while the design complements the surrounding greenery. The residences are delivered unfurnished, and the kitchens are provided without appliances, allowing residents to personalise their interiors and select appliances according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Elvira is situated in Dubai Hills Estate, a master-planned community within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, strategically positioned between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. With convenient access to Al Khail Road, the area provides connectivity to major business districts, retail destinations, and lifestyle attractions across Dubai, making it suitable for residents seeking a balance between urban convenience and a greener residential environment.

One of the community’s defining features is its 18-hole championship golf course, which adds expansive green views and a recreational dimension to the neighbourhood. Dubai Hills Park offers additional outdoor spaces for walking, exercise, and relaxation, creating opportunities to enjoy an active lifestyle surrounded by landscaped greenery.

Dubai Hills Estate is also home to Dubai Hills Mall, a major retail and entertainment destination featuring shopping, dining, and leisure options. The wider community provides access to educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and other everyday services. This combination of green spaces, recreational amenities, and urban infrastructure makes Dubai Hills Estate an appealing location for residents seeking a well-connected community with a focus on quality of life.
